title: Item Filter Icons
description: Custom icons for select items when named "item filter" with an anvil for easy recognition.
body:
A simple resouce pack to change filter items to Xs of the same material when named "item filter" with an anvil. This makes at-a-glance recognition of your item filters easy so you don't accidentally put them in your machines or storage system.

**Currently supports:**
- Copper Nuggets
- Iron Nuggets
- Gold Nuggets
- Lapis Lazuli
- Redstone
- Emeralds
- Diamonds (for those of you that like to flex)
